risk_statement: Compromise of privileged cloud administrator compromises critical hosting function
control_gap: Privileged MFA coverage and phishing resistance not evidenced
existing_controls: MFA asserted for some admins (SIM-E01); no independent validation
scoring_rationale: Unverified partial MFA claim (SIM-E01) gets no risk-reduction credit. Inherent likelihood 4 and severe impact 5 remain until full administrator coverage, policy enforcement and exceptions are evidenced.

risk_statement: Cloud regional disruption causes prolonged client service outage
control_gap: Workload-specific recovery objectives and exit testing absent
scoring_rationale: Generic backup/restore claim (SIM-E02) does not demonstrate workload-specific recovery or impact reduction. Retain likelihood 3 and impact 5 until scenario-specific recovery/exit evidence is evaluated.

risk_statement: Payroll subprocessor access exposes employee personal data
control_gap: Signed processor terms and subprocessor evidence missing
existing_controls: Encryption and limited HR roles claimed (SIM-E03)
scoring_rationale: Encryption is only asserted (SIM-E03), and signed processor terms are missing (SIM-E04). No validated reduction to probability or impact; separate GDPR contract gate remains unresolved.

risk_statement: Payroll SaaS outage delays staff payment processing
control_gap: No demonstrated export and manual cutover test
scoring_rationale: Unverified fallback claim (SIM-E05) does not establish reduced outage probability or payroll impact. A witnessed export and cutover drill is required before updating risk.

risk_statement: Overprivileged support agents access customer ticket data unnecessarily
control_gap: Broad roles; no entitlement review evidence
existing_controls: Login MFA asserted; lacks least-privilege controls
scoring_rationale: Support MFA is only claimed and the RBAC review is missing (SIM-E06); no evidence demonstrates lower misuse probability. Broad ticket access remains a major potential impact.

risk_statement: Supplier fails to notify AFS promptly after a security incident
control_gap: No contract notification clock, contact or reporting test
scoring_rationale: No incident notification evidence exists (SIM-E07), so no risk reduction is credited; original residual already matched inherent.
